topic: Franky burned the Pluton blueprints and so kept them away from Treasure Tree Adam on Elbaf
title: Franky's Fire Kept Pluton Away From Elbaf's Tree
description: Franky's Enies Lobby fire may have been about more than Robin. Between Tom's Oro Jackson, the Thousand Sunny, and Treasure Tree Adam on Elbaf, here is a theory about what he really kept apart. Do you buy it?
comment: Did Franky burn the Pluton plans for Robin, or to keep them away from Adam Wood? Pick one.

lines.text: Franky's Enies Lobby fire was never only about Robin.
